title: Security Eng Sync Notes - 2026-03-20
body:
Attendees: Marcus Li (owner), Aisha Patel, Sofia Ramirez, Daniel Kim, Evelyn Cooper, Security Oncall

Agenda:
- Quick vuln triage: open issues and prioritization
- Secrets posture: recent findings from repo-scan and actions
- Threat modeling: Private Deployments (VPC) network flows
- Action items and owners

1) Vulnerability triage (summary)
- SEC-482: High - unauthenticated path discovery in metrics endpoint. Repro steps attached in JIRA. Assigned to Daniel. Initial plan: add auth guard + rate limit. ETA for patch: 2026-03-25. Temporary mitigation: disable public metrics by default; config flag shipped today.
- DEP-317: Medium - dependency (lib-tokens v2.1.9) with moderate CVE. Aisha to validate if used in runtime path. If yes, upgrade to 2.2.1 and run integration tests. Blocker for Dedicated 2.4.
- Internal note: triage queue has grown after last deploy; recommend one rotation for oncall to focus on low/medium backlog this week.

Decision: Prioritize SEC-482 hotfix + lib-tokens upgrade. Blocker escalations go to Marcus.

2) Secrets & key management
- Repo-scan results (yesterday): 4 findings flagged by git-secrets across private repos. Two were false positives (test fixtures), two were real (leaked test API key and a k8s kubeconfig snippet).
  - Action: Evelyn to coordinate immediate rotation for leaked test API key (ROT-2026-03-20-1). Rotated key to be deployed to staging by EOD 2026-03-20.
  - Kubeconfig snippet: flagged in a forked repo backup. Aisha to confirm if any cluster access was possible; scope seems limited. Audit logs to be pulled.
- GitHub Actions: current runner logs retention contains secrets in some older artifacts. Short-term: purge artifacts >30d (Aisha). Long-term: enable ephemeral runner credentials and rotate organization-level tokens quarterly (Sofia to draft runbook).
- Secret scanning coverage: we are at ~78% for active repos. Target: 95% by end of Q2. Plan: expand repo allowlist, onboard infra repos next sprint.

3) Threat modeling: Private Deployments (VPC & on-prem)
- Background: new customers expect cross-account VPC peering and customer-managed NAT. We need threat model for lateral movement, data exfil, misconfigured peering.
- Key attack surfaces identified:
  - Peering misconfig with overly permissive IAM or route tables
  - Misconfiguration of private control plane exposing metadata endpoints
  - Improper KMS/HSM policies allowing key export via compromised admin
- Proposed mitigations:
  - Harden default route tables and deny-by-default security groups for private deployments
  - Add an automated checklist in deploy pipeline to verify control plane endpoints are private and not reachable from public internet (Sofia to prototype pre-deploy check)
  - Enforce least-privilege for KMS keys and require dual-approval for key rotation for Private customers (policy + audit).
- Threat modeling next steps: schedule focused workshop with Platform Eng and Private Deployments leads next Wed 2026-03-25. Draft threat model doc on Confluence: CONFLUENCE-SEC-threat-modeling-vpc (Sofia owner).

4) Operational items & observability
- Incident playbook: update for SEC-482 hotfix flow; include quick rollback steps for Dedicated pools. Marcus will push initial edits today.
- Logging: ensure audit logs for key usage are forwarded to SIEM for Private customers (Evelyn to confirm with Infra).
- Canary tests: add end-to-end canary that exercises auth guard on metrics endpoint to catch regressions (Daniel).

5) Action items (summary)
- Daniel Kim: implement patch for SEC-482, add canary test, ETA 2026-03-25.
- Aisha Patel: upgrade lib-tokens if in runtime path; purge GH artifacts >30d; coordinate kubeconfig audit. ETA: 2026-03-24.
- Evelyn Cooper: rotate leaked test API key, confirm SIEM forwarding for key usage. ETA: 2026-03-20 (rotation), 2026-03-27 (SIEM check).
- Sofia Ramirez: draft KMS dual-approval runbook + prototype pre-deploy private endpoint check; lead threat-modeling workshop 2026-03-25.
- Marcus Li: update incident playbook, escalate blockers, coordinate Dedicated rollout gating. Ongoing.

Notes / Open questions:
- Should we force-enable secret scanning for forks or only mainline branches? Ops tradeoffs re: noise vs coverage. (TODO: decision by security leadership by 2026-03-23)
- Rollout of KMS dual-approval may impact onboarding time for Private customers; need product sync before policy finalization. Marcus to schedule.

Next sync: 2026-03-27 (standup-style; escalate blockers beforehand in #security-oncall).

Links / references:
- JIRA: JIRA-SEC-482 (metrics endpoint)
- Threat model draft: CONFLUENCE-SEC-threat-modeling-vpc
